title.english: Apotheosis in Nine Acts: How I End Up Saving the World
synonyms: How I End Up Saving the World
Apotheosis in Nine Acts: How I End Up Saving the World

synopsis:
In Apotheosis in Nine Acts, streetwise rogue Chu Sheng stumbles into the world of immortal cultivation. He hopes to latch onto a powerful sect and coast his way to success, only to discover that the "Nine Arts of Ascension" is a deranged dark art that uses living people as nourishment. In the future, the human world has already been overrun by evil spirits—and even Chu Sheng, a Dao-heaven practitioner capable of "merging all things," is nothing more than a backup meal for the immortals.

He assembles a band of outrageous companions and travels through the future to hunt down evil spirits. His heavenly powers clash head-on with dark arts, while absurd comedy punctuates the bloody battles. The road to ascension is a near-certain death sentence. Want to become an immortal? First, try making it through tonight.

(Source: Bilibili)
